entries.text: declares the constructor. It has no visibility or return type.
. If none is written, there is an implicit one without parameters that sets nothing.
followed by the class name and the arguments creates the object. The parentheses are required.

blocks.description: The variable pasos starts empty. An object with the attribute valor is reserved, the constructor gives it 10 and finally pasos receives the reference to the object.

The reference to the object is stored in the variable.

runs.text: is a reservation instruction followed by a call to the constructor with the freshly created object as receiver.

points.text: creates an object and runs its constructor.
There is at most one constructor; without it, an implicit one that initializes nothing.
Declaring a class variable does not create the object.
